rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Purolite樹脂事業向けにプロテインAリガンドを長期契約で供給してきた
relations.text_en: Has supplied Protein A ligands to its Purolite resin business under long-term agreements

source.label: Repligen 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Historically, we manufactured multiple forms of Protein A ligands under long-term supply agreements with major life sciences companies including Cytiva (a standalone operating company owned by Danaher Corporation), MilliporeSigma and Ecolab Life Sciences ("Ecolab") for their Purolite ("Purolite") resin business.

relations.text: Ovivoの電子部門を16億ドルで買収(2025年12月)
relations.text_en: Acquired Ovivo's electronics business for $1.6 billion (December 2025)

source.label: Ecolab 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 16, 2025, we acquired Ovivo's electronics business ("Ovivo Electronics") for total consideration of $1.6 billion in cash.

relations.text: 手術用品事業(Microtek)を9.05億ドルでMedlineに売却(2024年8月)
relations.text_en: Sold its Microtek surgical business to Medline for $905 million (August 2024)

source.label: Medline 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On August 1, 2024, the Company acquired all of the outstanding shares of the global surgical solutions business of Ecolab (the "Microtek" business) pursuant to a share purchase agreement for $ 905 million cash consideration.

relations.text: 化学品事業(Chemical Technologies)を分離・統合した会社。製品の相互供給契約を結んでいた
relations.text_en: Took over its Chemical Technologies business and had a cross supply agreement with it

source.label: ChampionX 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Revenue for the consolidated entity decreased $124.3 million, or 3%, in 2024 compared to the prior year primarily due to a decline in revenues in Latin America along with the expected decline in revenue derived from the Cross Supply and Product Transfer Agreement with Ecolab.

relations.text: Xylemが10-Kで、水処理サービスの主な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Xylem lists Ecolab first among key water services competitors

source.label: Xylem 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our key competitors in the Water Solutions and Services segment include Ecolab, MPW Industrial Services, Ovivo, Sunbelt Rentals and United Rentals.

relations.text: STERISが10-Kで、競合の一社として挙げる

source.label: STERIS 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: Competitors include Belimed, Contec, Ecolab, Fedegari, Getinge, and Stilmas.

relations.text: Rollinsが10-Kで、主な競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Rollins names Ecolab among major competitors

source.label: Rollins 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors include Rentokil, Ecolab, Anticimex, and numerous other regional and local companies.

companies.name: レントキル・イニシャル

relations.text: Rentokilが20-F添付資料で、衛生サービスの競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Rentokil names Ecolab among hygiene services competitors

source.label: Rentokil Initial 20-F添付資料(2024年度)
source.quote: Citron Hygiene Canada Limited, and Ecolab Inc. in hygiene services

relations.text: TOMIが10-Kで、過酸化水素系の競合として挙げる(Bioquellの親会社)
relations.text_en: TOMI names Ecolab (owner of Bioquell) among hydrogen peroxide competitors

source.label: TOMI Environmental Solutions 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Comparable competitors include companies marketing hydrogen peroxide-based products, such as Steris Corporation, Bioquell (owned by Ecolab), and The Clorox Company
